fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models

Class StandardAtomicModelFactory

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.AbstractAtomicModelFactory
      • fr.sorbonne_u.devs_simulation.models.StandardAtomicModelFactory
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    AtomicModelFactoryI, java.io.Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    StandardAtomicHIOA_Factory, StandardRTAtomicModelFactory

    public class StandardAtomicModelFactory
extends AbstractAtomicModelFactory
    The class StandardAtomicModelFactory defines an atomic model factory that will create models from their Java representation class, assuming that this model class declares a constructor with the three standard parameters: the URI of the model, the simulation time unit and the simulation engine.

    Description

    To create a model, this factory uses reflection to get the standard constructor with the three mentioned parameters and then invokes it.

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       atomicModelClass != null

    Invariants

     invariant       DEBUG_LEVEL >= 0

    Created on : 2018-09-28

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant
